title: Build environment access expired for one specialist
description: One technical specialist could not sign in to the build environment.
resolution: Access was renewed by the customer contact.

title: Integration cannot be tested without credentials
description: End-to-end integration testing is stopped until access is provided.

title: Two report filters return wrong totals
description: Two filters double-count records during acceptance testing.
resolution: Filter logic was corrected and retested.

title: Training environment slow during sessions
description: Pages load slowly when more than one class uses the training environment.
resolution: Classes were moved to separate time slots.

title: Final data extract arrives one day late
description: The customer's final extract is scheduled one day after the planned date.
